name: maison-tanstack
description: From UX to AX: one set of Strapi MCP tools serving a LINE app, its concierge and staff. The customer app is TanStack Start, and every model call goes through TanStack AI.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix strapi && npm install --prefix app && node scripts/init-env.mjs
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n strapi,app,line-verify -c magenta,green,cyan "npm run develop --prefix strapi" "npm run dev --prefix app" "node --env-file-if-exists=app/.env scripts/mock-line-verify.mjs"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix app && npm test --prefix strapi/src/plugins/maison && node strapi/scripts/share-strapi-utils.mjs --check && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
